sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages thirty-three to thirty-six, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: blood alcohol percentages, crash percentages, break intervals, texting fines and points, and DUI fines, jail terms, suspension and revocation periods are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual; fine amounts are stated as the manual lists them and can change by law.
Accuracy flags: none open; physical page thirty-four repeats a short phrase at its top as a layout artifact and calls the texting ban a new law with its own fine schedule, so the texting facts are stated as the manual lists them and kept separate from the hands-free law covered in an earlier section; the sentence on the point-zero-five percent research begins on physical page thirty-four and ends on thirty-five, and it is cited to the page where it begins.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
